svg.title: At a glance: the paper's results
svg.desc: Animated summary: identification Spearman correlations of Table 1; attribution correlations 1.00, 0.98 and 0.88; ATC error 22.7 to 2.1 points; 6 of 8 unseen classifiers as registered; 109 rules with 54 pass, 13 partial, 14 fail and 28 reported; nine runs with registrations v1.0 to v8; run 9 produced every figure and table.
